start: ^I've recently become intersted in learning Japanese ever since I've grown closer to my friend
^We met at a young age when her family moved from Japan to my neighborhood in the US.
^Her assertive attitude and excess confidence in herself rubbed me the wrong way.
^But as time passed by, and we grew older, we got used to one another, and became friends.
^Now we're both 20-year-old college students, and we've become best friends to each other!
^I played a big role in her English learning journey, yet I never tried to learn Japanese seriously...
^! I found an exchange program that goes to Japan! We should do it together!
^！ 日本に行ける交換留学プログラム見つけたの！ 一緒に行こうよ！
^からそんなメッセージが届いた……。
^And so, my journey to learn Japanese... it's finally starting.
^こうして、俺の日本語学習の旅が……ついに始まる。
start2: ^ and I walk together through the hallways, getting used to our surroundings.
^Even though we've been here for a few weeks already, it still feels so different from back home.
^friend (Neutral): Yeah! It says here it's newly formed and they're looking for members.
^main_character: I don't know... I'm not into Japanese fashion like you are.
^friend (Neutral): Come on, it's gonna be fun!
^main_character: But I'm not interested in your fashion kei whatever,
^main_character: でも俺、お前の言う「おしゃれ」だか何だかにはあんまり興味ないんだって
^main_character: Yeah, but it's not something I'm going to wear.
^main_character: いや、服がかわいくても俺が着るわけじゃないだろ。
^main_character: Are there even fashion trends for men?
^main_character: そもそも男向けにも、そういうファッションの流行ってあるの？
^ you've asked me that before, of course there are!
^、それ前にも聞いてたよ？ もちろんあるよ！

^friend (Happy): Don't you want to learn more japanese? You can meet Japanese people in here!
